offerProposed: Demo offer proposed. Awaiting the learner’s exact consent; no deadline, work cap or allowance balance changed.
seed.planImpact: {days, plural, one {One more calendar day} other {# more calendar days}} to finish the existing plan, with no added work.

rejected: Demo rejection recorded. Nothing was granted and no allowance was used.

exceptionGranted: Demo exceptional grant recorded: {count, plural, one {one more day} other {# more days}}, with no allowance used.
cohortApplied: Demo deadline change applied to {count, plural, one {one learner} other {# learners}}.
migrated: Demo policy change applied. Open offers on changed parts were withdrawn.
accommodated: Demo accommodation recorded and applied to this learner only.
